他要像一棵树栽在溪水旁，
按时候结果子，叶子也不枯干。凡他所作的尽都顺利。

that produces its fruit in its season
whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.

你们众民当时时倚靠他，

在他面前傾心吐意；
神是我們的避難所。（細拉）
Trust in him at all times
you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.

able to have love for God whom he has not seen?
